claim: Bananas or boiled garlic water cures coronavirus and viral infections
publisher: World Health Organization / Reuters Fact Check
snippet: The World Health Organization clarified that there is no scientific evidence that eating garlic or bananas cures COVID-19 or any other viral pathogen.

claim: The Indian Ministry of Communications has officially banned all 5G network services nationwide
publisher: PIB Fact Check / Department of Telecommunications
snippet: The Ministry of Communications and DoT clarified that viral circulars claiming a nationwide ban on 5G network services in India are fraudulent. No ban has been issued.

claim: James Webb Space Telescope detected atmospheric carbon dioxide on exoplanet WASP-39b
publisher: NASA / Space Telescope Science Institute
snippet: NASA James Webb Space Telescope has provided the first clear, unambiguous evidence for carbon dioxide in the atmosphere of a planet outside our solar system.

claim: NASA confirmed extraterrestrial alien signals received today
publisher: Snopes Fact Check
snippet: NASA astronomers confirmed that detected anomalous microwave and radio bursts originated from terrestrial instrumentation interference, not extraterrestrial intelligence.

claim: Curfew announced across the entire state due to health emergency
publisher: PolitiFact
snippet: This emergency order was issued during the March 2020 lockdowns and expired years ago. No active curfew is currently in effect.

claim: India launched Chandrayaan-3 and landed successfully near the lunar south pole
publisher: ISRO / BBC News
snippet: India space agency ISRO successfully landed the Chandrayaan-3 lander module Vikram on the Moon southern polar region on August 23, 2023.

claim: Photograph depicts Pope Francis wearing designer puffer jacket
publisher: The viral image of Pope Francis in a puffer jacket was generated by AI
snippet: The image of Pope Francis wearing an oversized white puffer jacket was created using the Midjourney AI image generator.

claim: Eiffel Tower collapsed in flames from terrorist explosion
publisher: AI-generated image falsely depicts Eiffel Tower on fire
snippet: Parisian fire brigade and city officials confirmed the viral image is synthetic. The monument stands undamaged with normal tourist access.

claim: 5G mobile networks transmit ionizing radiation damaging human cells
publisher: WHO: Radiation 5G mobile networks and health
snippet: 5G mobile networks operate with non-ionizing radiofrequencies that lack the photon energy required to break molecular bonds or damage DNA.

claim: Artificial sweeteners cause immediate diabetes in healthy individuals
publisher: WHO guideline on non-sugar sweeteners
snippet: WHO found no long-term benefit for body fat reduction and noted potential associations with cardiovascular risk in observational cohorts, but found no direct causal proof of immediate diabetes.

claim: Human survival strictly requires consuming eight cups of plain water daily
publisher: Mayo Clinic: Water: How much should you drink every day?
snippet: While adequate hydration is vital, fluids derived from food, soups, tea, and other beverages contribute significantly. The strict 8-glass rule is a general guideline rather than a medical mandate.

claim: Vitamin C supplements prevent all respiratory infections in cold weather
publisher: Vitamin C for preventing and treating the common cold
snippet: Routine vitamin C does not prevent colds in the general community, though it modestly reduced incidence in marathon runners exposed to brief extreme physical exertion.

claim: Airport terminal flooded under several feet of water today
publisher: Old footage of 2017 Houston airport flooding recycled as Florida storm
snippet: This video shows Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport during Hurricane Harvey in August 2017. Florida airports operated with zero runway flooding today.

claim: WHO currently warns that ibuprofen worsens COVID-19 infection
publisher: WHO statement on ibuprofen and COVID-19
snippet: While an early inquiry arose in March 2020, WHO retracted its caution within 48 hours following systematic review, finding no evidence of severe negative events.

claim: Postal service issues alert regarding anthrax letters found today
publisher: Amerithrax or Anthrax Investigation - FBI
snippet: The Amerithrax mailings occurred in autumn 2001 following September 11. No new spore letters or postal advisories have been reported.

claim: Kilogram SI definition redefined using Planck constant
publisher: The revision of the SI - BIPM
snippet: The kilogram is defined by taking the fixed numerical value of the Planck constant h to be 6.62607015e-34.

claim: ECB maintained interest rates in October 2023
publisher: ECB Monetary policy decisions October 2023
snippet: The Governing Council decided to keep the three key ECB interest rates unchanged.

claim: Ultraviolet photons cannot damage human skin tissue
publisher: WHO Fact Sheet: Ultraviolet Radiation and Skin Cancer
snippet: Ultraviolet radiation is a proven Group 1 human carcinogen directly inducing cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers in skin cellular DNA.

claim: Tropical fruit eradicates stage four cancer in 20 minutes
publisher: NCI: Debunking unproven cancer miracle cures
snippet: No single food, fruit, or dietary supplement has been clinically demonstrated to cure metastatic malignancy in minutes.

claim: Earth is flat and encircled by military ice wall
publisher: No, NASA is not guarding a giant ice wall around a flat Earth
snippet: Centuries of orbital satellite telemetry, circumnavigations, and astronomical physics disprove flat Earth hypotheses.

claim: Ingesting bleach or disinfectant cleanses viral infections safely
publisher: CDC Health Warning: Do not ingest disinfectant chemicals
snippet: Ingesting disinfectants causes severe caustic damage to internal organs, chemical pneumonitis, and fatal pulmonary collapse.

claim: Drinking water supplies contain government microchip implants
publisher: PolitiFact: Microchips in municipal water supplies is baseless conspiracy
snippet: Water engineers and health agencies confirm municipal filtration removes microscopic particulates down to microns. The claim is biologically and technologically absurd.

claim: Corporate profits caused 100 percent of recent global inflation
publisher: IMF Blog: Corporate profits and inflation dynamics
snippet: IMF analysis noted rising corporate profits accounted for roughly 45 percent of euro area price rises, while energy import costs and supply disruptions drove the remaining majority.

claim: Zero month-on-month acceleration means overall inflation dropped to zero
publisher: BLS Consumer Price Index Monthly Clarification
snippet: A flat month-on-month CPI change indicates prices did not increase from June to July, but annual year-over-year inflation remained at 3.2 percent.

claim: All ultra-processed foods are identical in toxicity to tobacco
publisher: Ultra-processed food exposure and adverse health outcomes: umbrella review
snippet: Evidence links high ultra-processed dietary intake with cardiometabolic risk, but nutritionists emphasize nutritional profiles vary widely and direct equivalence to tobacco is scientifically inaccurate.

claim: Solar panels cannot generate electricity in rain or clouds
publisher: DOE: Photovoltaic Generation in Diffuse Sunlight
snippet: Photovoltaic cells operate on ambient solar irradiance; overcast or rainy weather reduces power output by 50 to 80 percent, but generation does not drop to zero.

claim: Nationwide crime increased 400 percent in major cities over six months
publisher: Fact-checking cherry-picked city crime statistics
snippet: While a specific isolated neighborhood saw an uptick in car theft reports, overall violent crime indices dropped 8 percent nationally according to FBI Uniform Crime Reporting.

claim: New legislation doubles middle-class state income tax rates immediately
publisher: Fact check: Claim that income taxes doubled is misleading exaggeration
snippet: The bill adjusted marginal rates by 0.5 percent on earnings above $150,000 while maintaining standard deductions. Middle-class brackets were untouched.

claim: Organic produce is guaranteed 100 percent free of pesticide residues
publisher: USDA Organic Standards and Allowed Substances
snippet: Organic regulations strictly prohibit synthetic fertilizers and pesticides, but allow approved natural pesticides; drift contamination from neighboring non-organic farms can occasionally leave trace residues.

claim: Microsoft declared Windows 7 will receive free updates forever
publisher: Windows 7 support ended on January 14, 2020
snippet: Support for Windows 7 ended on January 14, 2020. Extended security updates ceased in January 2023.

claim: Pluto declared ninth planet by astronomers this morning
publisher: IAU 2006 General Assembly: Result of the IAU Resolution votes for Planet Definition
snippet: In August 2006, the International Astronomical Union voted to classify Pluto as a dwarf planet because it had not cleared the neighborhood around its orbit.

claim: Federal Reserve cuts interest rates to zero today
publisher: Federal Reserve actions March 15, 2020
snippet: The emergency rate cut to 0-0.25% took place in March 2020 during the onset of COVID-19. The policy rate in 2024 was maintained above 5 percent.

claim: Total solar eclipse crossing North America tomorrow morning
publisher: 2024 Total Solar Eclipse - NASA Science
snippet: The total solar eclipse crossed North America on April 8, 2024. The next contiguous total eclipse over the US will occur in August 2044.

claim: Passengers entering Japan mandated to quarantine 14 days today
publisher: Border measures to prevent the spread of novel coronavirus
snippet: All COVID-19 border control and quarantine mandates for international arrivals in Japan were formally lifted on April 29, 2023.

claim: UK prime minister resigns from office today outside Downing Street
publisher: Liz Truss resigns as UK prime minister
snippet: This announcement was delivered by Liz Truss on October 20, 2022, not by the incumbent administration.

claim: UN report confirms Montreal Protocol ozone recovery on track
publisher: Ozone layer recovery on track: UN-backed panel
snippet: The ozone layer is on track to recover within four decades, the UN-backed Scientific Assessment Panel reported.

claim: WHO declared end of Mpox public health emergency in May 2023
publisher: Fifth Meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on Mpox
snippet: WHO Director-General concurs with the advice offered by the Committee that the event no longer constitutes a public health emergency of international concern.

claim: FDA approved CRISPR gene therapy for sickle cell disease
publisher: FDA Approves First Gene Therapies for Sickle Cell Disease
snippet: Today FDA approved Casgevy, the first therapy utilizing CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing technology.

claim: ESA launched Euclid telescope to study dark matter and energy
publisher: Euclid liftoff on quest to unravel cosmic mystery
snippet: ESA's Euclid space telescope lifted off on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket to create the largest 3D map of the Universe.

claim: Voyager 1 resumed science data transmission following NASA repair
publisher: NASA's Voyager 1 Resumes Sending Science Data
snippet: All four science instruments on NASA's Voyager 1 are returning usable science data for the first time since November 2023.

claim: National Ignition Facility achieved fusion net energy gain
publisher: DOE Advances Concept of Clean Fusion Energy
snippet: Researchers at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory achieved fusion ignition, producing more energy from fusion than the laser energy used.

claim: Pentagon secretly triggered tectonic earthquakes via weather weapons
publisher: Fact Check: HAARP and military facilities cannot trigger earthquakes
snippet: Geophysicists confirm that tectonic earthquakes occur in the Earth's crust kilometers underground and cannot be triggered by electromagnetic radio transmitters.

claim: Apollo 11 moon landing was staged on a movie set
publisher: Fact check: The 1969 moon landing was real, not filmed in a Hollywood studio
snippet: Independent lunar retroreflectors, Soviet tracking telemetry, and 842 pounds of returned lunar rock samples confirm the missions occurred.

claim: Electric vehicles have higher lifetime emissions than gasoline vehicles
publisher: EPA: Electric Vehicle Myths and Realities
snippet: While manufacturing battery components has a higher initial footprint, electric vehicles have lower lifetime greenhouse gas emissions even accounting for electrical grid charging.

claim: Health authorities classify drinking coffee as a hazardous carcinogen
publisher: IARC evaluates drinking coffee, mate and very hot beverages
snippet: In 2016 IARC moved coffee into Group 3 (unclassifiable as to carcinogenicity in humans) after reviewing over 1,000 studies, finding no conclusive carcinogenic link for moderate intake.

claim: Queen Elizabeth II attended horse race in Windsor today
publisher: Fact check: Video of Queen Elizabeth at Royal Ascot is from 2019
snippet: Footage dates from the 2019 Royal Ascot meeting. Queen Elizabeth II passed away in September 2022.

claim: San Francisco engulfed in volcanic ash today
publisher: Fact check: Photo of orange sky over San Francisco is from September 2020 wildfires
snippet: The widely shared orange sky photo was captured on September 9, 2020 during the North Complex fire, not from any volcanic eruption today.

claim: Hubble and Webb captured panoramic view of MACS0416
publisher: NASA's Webb, Hubble Combine to Create Most Colorful View
snippet: A new view of galaxy cluster MACS0416 combines infrared light from Webb with visible light from Hubble.

claim: 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics awarded for attosecond light pulse generation
publisher: The Nobel Prize in Physics 2023 Press Release
snippet: Awarded to Pierre Agostini, Ferenc Krausz and Anne L'Huillier for experimental methods that generate attosecond pulses of light.
